```yaml
name: End-to-End Tests with Kind

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: CI Environment
            env: ci
            setup-script: .github/scripts/setup-ci.sh
          - name: KIND Environment
            env: kind
            setup-script: .github/scripts/setup-kind.sh
          - name: HyperShift Environment
            env: hypershift
            setup-script: .github/scripts/setup-hypershift.sh

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-xdist pytest-html playwright
        
    - name: Setup Environment
      run: ${{ matrix.setup-script }}
      
    - name: Run UI Tests
      run: |
        # Run Playwright tests
        npx playwright test --reporter=html
        # Run custom test script for CI environment
        if [ "${{ matrix.env }}" = "ci" ]; then
          bash .github/scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh
        fi
        
    - name: Upload Playwright Report
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: playwright-report-${{ matrix.env }}
        path: playwright-report/
        retention-days: 30
        
    - name: Upload Test Results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: test-results-${{ matrix.env }}
        path: |
          test-results/
          *.xml
        retention-days: 30
        
    - name: Debug Information
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "Environment: ${{ matrix.env }}"
        echo "Test failures detected"
        ls -la
        cat /tmp/test.log || echo "No log file found"

  validate-skill-instructions:
    needs: e2e-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Validate Skill Instructions
      run: |
        # Verify skill files exist and contain expected content
        if [ ! -f "skills/tdd:ci.md" ] || [ ! -f "skills/tdd:kind.md" ] || [ ! -f "skills/tdd:hypershift.md" ]; then
          echo "Skill files not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check for UI test sections in each skill
        grep -q "UI Tests (Playwright)" skills/tdd:ci.md && echo "CI skill has UI tests section" || echo "ERROR: CI skill missing UI tests section"
        grep -q "UI Tests (Playwright)" skills/tdd:kind.md && echo "KIND skill has UI tests section" || echo "ERROR: KIND skill missing UI tests section"
        grep -q "UI Tests (Playwright)" skills/tdd:hypershift.md && echo "HyperShift skill has UI tests section" || echo "ERROR: HyperShift skill missing UI tests section"
        
        # Validate specific content patterns
        echo "Validating CI environment setup..."
        grep -q "91-run-ui-tests.sh" skills/tdd:ci.md && echo "CI script reference found" || echo "ERROR: CI script reference missing"
        
        echo "Validating KIND environment setup..."
        grep -q "port-forwarded backend" skills/tdd:kind.md && echo "KIND port forwarding mentioned" || echo "ERROR: KIND port forwarding missing"
        grep -q "Keycloak login" skills/tdd:kind.md && echo "KIND Keycloak login mentioned" || echo "ERROR: KIND Keycloak login missing"
        
        echo "Validating HyperShift environment setup..."
        grep -q "OpenShift routes" skills/tdd:hypershift.md && echo "HyperShift routes mentioned" || echo "ERROR: HyperShift routes missing"
        grep -q "TLS handling" skills/tdd:hypershift.md && echo "HyperShift TLS mentioned" || echo "ERROR: HyperShift TLS missing"
        
        echo "All validations completed successfully"
```
